title: Kota Kinabalu vs Kuching: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Kota Kinabalu for beaches, diving, and Mt. Kinabalu. Kuching for food, culture, and easy orangutan access. Do both if you have 10+ days.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Sarawak laksa and kolo mee make Kuching one of Malaysia's best food cities. KK is solid but lacks a distinct regional identity.

categories.name: Wildlife
categories.summary: Kinabatangan River (wild orangutans, pygmy elephants) and Sepilok give KK the wildlife edge. Kuching's Semenggoh is easier to visit.

categories.name: Beaches & Islands
categories.summary: KK has Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park and world-class Sipadan diving. Kuching has no accessible beaches.

categories.name: Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Sarawak Museum, Brooke heritage architecture, and genuine longhouse access make Kuching the cultural capital of Borneo.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Kuching is slightly cheaper for city travel. KK's major experiences (Kinabatangan, Sipadan) add significant cost.

faq.question: Is Kota Kinabalu or Kuching better for first-time Borneo visitors?
faq.answer: Depends on priorities. KK for beaches/mountains/diving; Kuching for food, walkable city, and easy orangutan access.

faq.question: Which is better for seeing orangutans?
faq.answer: Kuching for ease (Semenggoh 30 min from city); KK for wild encounters via Kinabatangan River.
